examples: Your phone is also open on the session, so the desktop view shows empty space: the notice tells you why.
how_to: Read the notice: another device has the session at a smaller size, and the pane shows that grid.
Close the other device's view, or make it larger, and the pane grows again.
media_exempt: only appears while a second, smaller device is attached to the same session, which one capture browser cannot reproduce faithfully
name: Window-larger-than-pane notice
summary: warn you when your window is bigger than a session's pane, so you know why there's empty space.
where: Appears over a terminal when your window is larger than the session's pane.
